name: Slice Transition
description: The second clip replaces the first in ten thin slices that open in a staggered sweep. `direction` picks the sweep and the slice axis. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: 0 = hlslice (vertical slices, sweep from the left), 1 = hrslice (from the right), 2 = vuslice (horizontal slices, sweep from the top), 3 = vdslice (from the bottom)
